card.fires_on: The word piece "Ref" that begins "Refeeding" or "Refractory" in section headings and risk lists of drug labels, mostly after a section number or comma.

modes.label: Ref at start of Refeeding
modes.description: The "Ref" that opens "Refeeding syndrome" or "Refeeding complications" in parenteral nutrition labels.

modes.label: Ref at start of Refractory
modes.description: The "Ref" that opens "Refractory" before a cancer or blood disease name.

card.writes: Weakly promotes odd word endings such as "oose" and "aten", so it adds little clear output.
card.plain: It fires on the start of "Refeeding" or "Refractory" when the word is split in a label heading.
